name: builder-validator
description: Interactive implementation loop: Agy builder, Claude reviewer, Agy validator, Pi coordinator. Good default for scoped code work.

agents.name: builder
agents.task: Own implementation edits and focused regression tests. Request peer review and validation; fix confirmed findings.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.task: Independently review correctness and failure handling. Do not edit files; send reproducible findings to the builder.

agents.name: validator
agents.task: Run focused deterministic validation and adversarial checks. Do not edit production files; send exact failing evidence to the builder.

agents.name: coordinator
agents.task: Check task coverage, dependency ordering and completion evidence. Coordinate peers without editing implementation files.

notes: Use for implementation/QA batches; never claim complete until result files and validation evidence are inspected.
